name: stack-scan
description: Know what is installed, keep it healthy, find what to add. /stack-scan:report inventories manifests, lockfiles (composer, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun), runtimes and docker images into a required-vs-installed table with drift, missing locks and EOL majors flagged. /stack-scan:audit runs the composer/npm vulnerability, outdated and licence checks — report-only. /stack-scan:suggest suggests every marketplace plugin in three tiers with cited evidence (--yes auto-installs tiers 1-2, --full the stack-relevant set after one confirm, --persist/--global set scope); --skills searches skills.sh for third-party skills — explicit picks only. Add-at-all is approaches' build-vs-buy.

cc_version_pins.title: Installed-version pins (CC_VERSION_PINS)
cc_version_pins.description: Prepend the installed npm version to a skill whose Last verified stamp names that package: on or off. The environment variable CC_VERSION_PINS overrides this.
